#### 🚀 Core SDK & Agent Session Runtime
Functions and classes to initialize and manage the main agent logic.

*   `createAgentSession(options?: CreateAgentSessionOptions): Promise<CreateAgentSessionResult>` - Main entry point to create an AI coding agent session.
*   `createAgentSessionRuntime(options: ...): CreateAgentSessionRuntimeResult` - Creates the runtime wrapper handling the loop.
*   `createAgentSessionServices(options: CreateAgentSessionServicesOptions): Promise<AgentSessionServices>` - Sets up underlying services.
*   `createAgentSessionFromServices(options: CreateAgentSessionFromServicesOptions): Promise<CreateAgentSessionResult>` - Alternative initialization.
*   **Classes & Key Types:**
    *   `AgentSession` - Manages the interaction cycle, models, and tools.
    *   `AgentSessionRuntime` - Encapsulates session, context, and runner instances.
    *   `SessionManager` - Manages chat history trees, loading/saving to files.
    *   `AgentSessionEvent`, `AgentSessionEventListener`, `ModelCycleResult`, `SessionStats`, `PromptOptions`, `ParsedSkillBlock`.

#### 🧩 Extensions API
Methods and types to build, register, and run extensions dynamically.

*   `createExtensionRuntime(): ExtensionRuntime`
*   `discoverAndLoadExtensions(configuredPaths: string[], cwd: string, agentDir?: string, eventBus?: EventBus): Promise<LoadExtensionsResult>`
*   `loadExtensions(paths: string[], cwd: string, eventBus?: EventBus): Promise<LoadExtensionsResult>`
*   `loadExtensionFromFactory(factory: ExtensionFactory, cwd: string, eventBus: EventBus, runtime: ExtensionRuntime, ...): Promise<Extension>`
*   `defineTool(definition: ToolDefinition)` - Used by extensions to define custom tools.
*   `wrapRegisteredTool(...)` / `wrapRegisteredTools(...)` - Wraps raw definitions for the runner.
*   `ExtensionRunner` class - Executes loaded extensions.
*   **Key Types:** `ExtensionAPI`, `ExtensionContext`, `ExtensionFactory`, `ExtensionCommandContext`, `ExtensionWidgetOptions`, `ExtensionEvent` (Union of all agent events).
